answer: Port scanning works as a method for adversaries to discover services running on remote hosts and local network infrastructure devices. This technique, known as Network Service Discovery, involves acquiring information about potentially vulnerable services through various scanning methods, including port scans, vulnerability scans, and wordlist scans. Tools are typically used to facilitate this process, allowing attackers to identify services that may be susceptible to remote software exploitation [Source 1].
